description: MMTC Limited operates as a trading company in Asia, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, Latin America, and North America. It operates through Minerals, Precious Metals, Metals, Agro Products, Coal & Hydrocarbon, Fertilizer, and General Trade/others segments. The company engages in the export of minerals; and import of precious metals, non-ferrous metals, fertilizers, agro products, coal and hydrocarbon, etc. It also trades in minerals, metals, fertilizers, agro products, coal and hydrocarbons, bullion, jewellery, and other commodities. MMTC Limited was incorporated in 1963 and is based in New Delhi, India.
